$comment: Advisories examined and found not reachable in the deployed runtime.
Every entry must say WHY, with enough detail that the next person can
check the claim rather than trust it. An advisory absent from this file
fails the gate — that is the point.
This is not a severity threshold and must not become one.

advisories.reason: The Prisma CLI, reachable only as a PEER dependency of @prisma/client. @prisma/client declares no runtime dependencies of its own (verified in node_modules/@prisma/client/package.json), so the CLI and its tree are build-and-generate-time only and are not loaded serving a request. The published fix is a semver-major DOWNGRADE to prisma 6.12.0, which is a data-layer decision rather than a patch — tracked as a product decision, not silently accepted.
Pulled in by the Prisma CLI for config loading. Same reachability analysis as `prisma`: build/generate time only, never on a request path.

Transitive through @prisma/config, so it inherits that reachability: CLI configuration parsing, not request handling. The advisory affects merge behaviour on untrusted input, and the only input here is the repository's own prisma config.
